title: crepidium floscularium
intro: Crepidium floscularium, commonly known as the "Ghost Orchid", is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is native to Central and South America, particularly in the countries of Costa Rica and Panama. Research has shown that the plant has potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Crepidium floscularium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiviral effects.
